ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (~45:55 white-to-black pixel distribution) with sharp transitions between high-intensity white patches and low-intensity black regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches located on the distal halves of both lobes. The left lobe (viewer perspective) contains a broad triangular white region extending from the tip toward the midline. The right lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits a narrower white band localized along the trailing edge and tip. The central region surrounding the notch is entirely black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a defined vertex at the fluke midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration map along the trailing boundary featuring semi-circular scalloped peaks with varying pixel amplitudes of 5-15 units relative to the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Highly convex curvature on leading edges; trailing edges follow a sigmoidal curve with a concave sweep approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, textured tan and white pixel groups at the distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to active barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontal dark linear disruptions visible within the high-intensity white patch of the left lobe (viewer perspective).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, discrete dark circular mottling spots distributed within the interior of the primary white patch on the left lobe (viewer perspective).
